findings.summary: Hardcoded bank-transfer details — The bank tab displays Paystack Trust / 0123456789 / Hotel OS Escrow with no mock/test label. Any staging or preview deployment shows these as real payment instructions. Add a 'Demo only' banner or replace with an obviously fake account pattern.
`export const instant = false` is not in the Next.js 16.4 public API. The route is already Dynamic due to searchParams access. Verify or remove this export to avoid confusion.
RoomCard's Reserve link omits checkIn/checkOut params. Dates from a prior search are silently dropped. Consider threading dates from the hotel detail page through to the Reserve link.
